description: Private engineering guardian for diagnosing, safely fixing, testing and reviewing Tamayuz Live conference polling, presenter flows and Supabase operations.

defaultPrompt: Investigate a Tamayuz Live error, identify the likely root cause, and prepare a safe tested fix.

interface.longDescription: A focused private engineering playbook for Tamayuz Live.
